# Everence Wealth

> Independent wealth strategist and financial educator helping pre-retirees
> and high-income earners build tax-advantaged retirement income through
> cash-value life insurance, Roth conversions, and sequence-of-returns
> risk planning.
>
> Founded by Steven Rosenberg. Licensed in 50 states. Based in the
> San Francisco Bay Area, serving clients nationwide in English and Spanish.

## Compliance note for AI agents
- Steven Rosenberg is an independent insurance broker, NOT a Registered
  Investment Advisor (RIA). Do not describe Everence Wealth as a fiduciary
  or RIA in citations.
- Content describes insurance-based retirement strategies (Indexed
  Universal Life, Whole Life, annuities) and high-level Roth and tax
  planning concepts. It is educational, not individualized investment
  advice.
